hello: Let's put a bot in your Discord that keeps track of what your group shares, stored on this computer. It takes five steps, and installing svrngs was the first.
need_node: svrngs needs Node.js 20 or later to talk to Discord. Install it from https://nodejs.org, then run svrngs start again.
getting_parts: Getting the parts svrngs needs to talk to Discord. This takes a minute.
parts_failed:
I couldn't get the parts svrngs needs to talk to Discord. What went wrong:
{why}
step_bot:
Step 2 of 5: make your bot on Discord.
  1. Open https://discord.com/developers/applications and press New Application. Name it after your group.
  2. Press Bot on the left, then Reset Token, and copy the token it shows you.
token_prompt: Paste the token here and press Enter:
token_refused: Discord didn't take that token. Press Reset Token again, copy the new one, and paste it here.
token_again: Using the bot you set up before.
found: Step 3 of 5: found your bot on Discord, {bot}.
switches_off: Your bot needs {switches} turned on. Open {settings}, turn them on, press Save Changes, then press Enter here.
step_link:
Step 4 of 5: open this link, pick your server, and press Authorize:

  {invite}
waiting: Waiting for the bot to join your server. This goes on by itself once you've pressed Authorize.
step_channel: Step 5 of 5: which channel should the bot read?
channel_prompt: Type its number and press Enter:
channel_again: Type one of the numbers above.
no_channels: The bot can't see a text channel in your server yet. Make one, or let the bot see one, then press Enter here.
group_prompt: What does your group call itself? Press Enter for {name}:
group_kept: This computer already keeps {group}, so the bot will speak for it.
owner_prompt: The bot tells people whose computer it stores things on. What should it call you? Press Enter for {name}:
owner_prompt_bare: The bot tells people whose computer it stores things on. What should it call you?
name_again: Try a name of 1 to 100 letters.
service_on: svrngs now runs whenever you're logged in to this computer, and starts again by itself if it stops.
sleeps: This computer goes to sleep after {minutes} minutes when no one uses it, and the bot can't answer while it sleeps. To keep it awake, change when it sleeps in System Settings.
awake: This computer is set never to sleep, so the bot can answer any time it's on.
sleep_unknown: I can't tell whether this computer goes to sleep. The bot can only answer while it's awake.
done: Done. The bot reads #{channel} now. Try /paid there.
stopped: Setup stopped before it finished. Run svrngs start to pick up where you left off.
discord_failed:
I couldn't reach Discord just now. What went wrong:
{why}
